item.title: A Girl Unknown and Concrete Land top the Doha Film Festival awards
item.description:
The Doha Film Festival 2026 closed on Friday evening, awarding Chinese director Zou Jing's A Girl Unknown the $75,000 Best Narrative prize. Asmahan Bkerat's Concrete Land won Best Documentary and the FIPRESCI Prize, and Hamad Al-Fayhani's Crawling Into Myself won Best Film in the Made in Qatar competition. Prizes exceeded $300,000 after nine days of screenings, according to QNA and Deadline.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/28/doha-film-festival-2026-concludes-honours-bold-storytelling · Deadline https://deadline.com/2026/11/doha-2026-winners-girl-unknown-concrete-land-1237234325/

item.title: Doha closes the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference with consensus among 179 states
item.description:
The ITU Plenipotentiary Conference (PP-26) closed in Doha on Friday after three weeks of negotiations at the Doha Exhibition and Convention Center. Delegations signed the Final Acts, including the Union's strategic and financial plans for 2028-2031. The ITU said 179 member states reached consensus on priorities spanning artificial intelligence, digital resilience, global connectivity and space communications. The conference was chaired by Eng. Ahmad bin Abdulla Al Mosallmani, President of the Communications Regulatory Authority.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/itu-plenipotentiary-conference-2026-concludes-in-doha · International Telecommunication Union https://www.itu.int/en/mediacentre/Pages/PR-2026-11-27-PP26-closing.aspx

item.title: Education Minister: 2,426 tablets for students from low-income families
item.description:
Education and Higher Education Minister Lolwah bint Rashid Al Khater announced 2,426 tablets for eligible private school students under the Integration for Sustainable Education initiative with Qatar Charity. Launched on Thursday at the ministry's theatre, the initiative supports students from low-income families with school supplies and workshops on communication and leadership skills, and promotes volunteering and social responsibility in schools.

item.title: Qatar calls in Geneva for comprehensive protection of children online
item.description:
Qatar called for a comprehensive, balanced and multidimensional approach that places the best interests of the child at the heart of ICT policies and legislation, to protect children from risks in both digital and real-world environments. The statement was delivered by Abdulrahman Mohammed Fakhro, acting charge d'affaires of Qatar's Permanent Mission to the UN in Geneva, at the OHCHR Global Consultation on Child Rights and Safety in the Digital Environment.
Sources: Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739142/qatar/qatar-for-more-safeguards-for-children-in-digital-world · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/27/11/2026/qatar-stresses-need-to-protect-children-from-risks-in-digital-real-world-environments

item.title: Qatar lose 52-74 to South Korea in basketball qualifiers
item.description:
Qatar's basketball team lost 52-74 to South Korea in Doha on Thursday in the second window of the Asian Qualifiers for the 2027 World Cup, the first game under Tunisian coach Hatem Mamlouk, who replaced Turkey's Hakan Demir. Korea took the first quarter 23-11, and Seounghyun Lee led the scoring with 17 points. Qatar have qualified as hosts, and the qualifiers give them tough competition before the tournament.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739080/sport/basketball/qatar-outclassed-by-south-korea-in-world-cup-qualifiers · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266683/sports/qatar-cagers-lose-to-south-korea

item.title: Italy says the drone that killed two technicians in Kuwait was Iranian-made
item.description:
Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said Kuwaiti investigations established that the drone that killed two Italian technicians in Kuwait was made in Iran, stressing that this did not necessarily mean it was launched from Iranian territory. The technicians, Antonio Saccoccio, 65, and Emanuele Lo Russo, 36, were maintaining a Skyguard radar for Rheinmetall Italia. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi denied any role and offered to join a joint commission of inquiry.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/28/iran-war-live-italy-says-drone-in-deadly-kuwait-attack-was-made-in-iran · Arab Times (ANSA) https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/iran-made-drone-killed-two-italian-technicians-in-kuwait/

item.title: Houthi media say a Saudi strike killed 11 civilians in Taiz
item.description:
The Houthi-run Saba news agency said a Saudi strike on a residential building in al-Turbah, south of Taiz, killed 11 people on Friday, most of them children, and that other strikes targeted fuel tanks in Saada. The Saudi-led coalition said the same day it shot down a Houthi drone launched towards Riyadh.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/saudi-strike-kills-11-civilians-in-yemens-taiz-houthi-media · Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-tensions-trump-signals-victory-as-iran-offers-kuwait-drone-probe-1.500762639

item.title: Dubai stocks erase war losses in best month since 2020
item.description:
The DFM General Index rose 1.4% on Friday to around 6,575 points, above its pre-war close of 6,503.50 on 27 February, erasing all its losses since the war began. Its November gain of about 14% is the best since April 2020, moving Dubai from the Gulf's worst-performing market to its second-best this year, behind Oman. Banks and real estate led the rally, with Dubai Islamic Bank up about 11% on Monday and nearly 10% on Thursday.
Sources: Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/dubai-stocks-wipe-out-all-war-losses-as-banks-and-property-lead-rally · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/markets/2026/11/27/dubais-stock-market-rises-14-per-cent-in-november/

item.title: Iran cuts bread and fuel subsidies as the US blockade tightens
item.description:
Iran has begun cutting subsidies on essentials including bread and petrol and rationing electricity as the US naval blockade in place since July tightens, The Washington Post reported. President Masoud Pezeshkian said in a televised address: "We have no money." Statistical Centre of Iran data showed consumer prices up 88.7% year on year in October and food and beverage prices up 112.6%, while the rial fell to 2.9 million per dollar.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/iran-cuts-subsidies-as-us-blockade-deepens-economic-crisis-1.500762966 · Seoul Economic Daily https://en.sedaily.com/world/2026/11/27/we-have-no-money-irans-president-says-as-prices-soar

item.title: Oman and Japan discuss Strait of Hormuz tensions in Tokyo
item.description:
Omani Foreign Minister Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi and Japanese counterpart Toshimitsu Motegi discussed Middle East developments, including tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, in Tokyo on Thursday. Motegi asked for continued close cooperation to calm the region and praised Muscat's de-escalation efforts. The two agreed to expand cooperation in clean energy, supply chains, food security and defence, in their first face-to-face meeting since Motegi visited Oman in August.
Sources: Oman Ministry of Foreign Affairs https://www.fm.gov.om/en/66505/ · Nippon.com (Jiji Press) https://www.nippon.com/en/articles/-/58065 · Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179652-sayyid-badr-meets-with-his-japanese-counterpart-exchanges-views-on-developments-in-middle-east

item.title: Health Minister: Warraq fire death toll rises to 32, six critical
item.description:
Health and Population Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar announced on Friday evening that the death toll from the Ring Road fire in Warraq had risen to 32, after a patient with burns covering 75% of his body died at Bulaq al-Dakrour hospital. Of 26 injured, seven have been discharged and 19 remain in hospital, six of them in critical condition. The minister said no one is missing, and identifying some bodies will take days.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/28/3085590 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2537101 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7197138

item.title: Zamalek and Pyramids open their CAF Champions League group campaigns today
item.description:
Zamalek host Tunisia's Club Africain and Pyramids host Morocco's Maghreb de Fes today, Saturday, at 6pm Cairo time, as the CAF Champions League group stage opens. Zamalek play at Cairo International Stadium, their first meeting with Club Africain in 15 years, and Pyramids at Air Defence Stadium. Pyramids lead the Egyptian Premier League with a perfect record of 27 points from nine games.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2537107 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/sports/sports-arab-international/details/2026/11/28/3085607 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/28/x/7633983

item.title: Pope Leo XIV sends condolences to families of the Warraq crash victims
item.description:
Pope Leo XIV expressed deep sorrow for the victims of the Warraq crash in Cairo in a condolence telegram signed by Vatican Secretary of State Cardinal Pietro Parolin. The Pope offered condolences to the families of the dead, prayed for the victims and for the recovery of the injured, and affirmed his spiritual closeness to all those affected.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7197139 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=27112026&id=a4947b12-a9c1-4097-8af0-e9ee75d81959

item.title: Meteorological authority warns of dense fog and light rain on the north coast
item.description:
The Egyptian Meteorological Authority warned of dense fog today, Saturday, from 3am to 9am over the north coast, the Delta, Greater Cairo, the Canal cities, central Sinai and northern Upper Egypt, which may reduce visibility on roads. It forecast a 30% chance of light rain on the north coast, the northern Delta and Halayeb and Shalateen, with highs of 23-24 degrees in Cairo.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/28/3085615 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/28/x/7634514

item.title: Basketball league decider between Al Ahly and Al Ittihad moved to Monday
item.description:
The Egyptian Basketball Federation said the deciding game of the league final between Al Ahly and Al Ittihad Alexandria will be played on Monday at 7pm at the Cairo International Stadium hall. Federation president Amr Moselhy said the decision reflects Al Ahly's and Zamalek's African football fixtures this weekend and gives both teams time to rest.
Sources: Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=27112026&id=376f49b5-970c-4cbd-8f79-974ea9967eb2 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7197170

item.title: Taiwan votes in local elections led by a battle for Taipei mayor
item.description:
Voters in Taiwan choose mayors and councillors across 22 cities and counties today, Saturday, in "nine-in-one" elections for more than 11,000 posts. Polls are open from 8am to 4pm local time. Attention is on Taipei, where KMT mayor Chiang Wan-an faces a challenge from Puma Shen of the governing Democratic Progressive Party, who is wanted by Chinese police for "separatism".
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/28/taiwan-votes-in-local-elections-to-choose-mayors-other-leaders · ABC News (Australia) https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-28/what-are-taiwan-nine-in-one-elections/107433590

item.title: Spain wraps up its snap election campaign before Sunday's vote
item.description:
Spanish parties wrapped up campaigning before Sunday's snap general election on 29 November, with Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez saying he "can't conceive of losing" despite polls favouring the right. An average of 19 polls before the publication ban put the People's Party at 30.6% against 28.1% for the Socialists, with a PP-Vox coalition projected above the 176 seats needed for a majority.
Sources: Al Jazeera English (Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/spains-pedro-sanchez-bets-on-left-wing-voting-surge-to-defy-election-polls · Latin Times https://www.latintimes.com/spain-election-pp-leads-polls-feijoo-debate-601708

item.title: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets
item.description:
OpenAI filed counterclaims against Apple in a California federal court on Friday, accusing it of stealing trade secrets and blocking its access to hardware suppliers. OpenAI said Apple obtained confidential information about a new device by re-hiring an employee who had worked at OpenAI for six months, and that its planned devices threaten to outcompete Apple on its own turf. The filing responds to Apple's lawsuit accusing OpenAI of poaching its staff.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/27/openai-countersues-apple-over-trade-secrets-as-ai-race-heats-up · 9to5Mac https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/27/openai-countersues-apple-alleging-trade-secret-theft-and-supplier-threats/

item.title: Venezuela to repeal a law barring opposition figures from public office
item.description:
Venezuela's National Assembly chief Jorge Rodriguez announced the repeal of a 2024 law barring from office anyone who promoted or supported sanctions on the country, criticised for enabling political persecution. Rodriguez said the law "responded to a very specific moment". An interim government led by Delcy Rodriguez has run the country since January, holding talks with parts of the opposition, and has promised free elections without setting a date.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/venezuela-to-repeal-law-that-bans-opposition-figures-from-office · Le Temps https://www.letemps.ch/en/world/venezuela-moves-to-repeal-law-imposing-lifetime-bans-on-opposition-candidates

item.title: Marc Marquez announces MotoGP retirement after his eighth title
item.description:
Ducati rider Marc Marquez of Spain announced his retirement from MotoGP after the season-ending Valencia Grand Prix, just before first practice on Friday. "This will be my last race in MotoGP. We made history," the 33-year-old wrote in a message shown to TV cameras. The announcement came days after he won his eighth premier-class world title at the Portuguese Grand Prix.
Sources: Crash.net https://www.crash.net/motogp/news/1110937/1/marc-marquez-announces-motogp-retirement-days-after-winning-2026-title · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/27/11/2026/marc-marquez-announces-retirement-from-motogp · The Race https://www.the-race.com/motogp/marc-marquez-stuns-motogp-with-retirement-announcement/

item.title: Thailand and Cambodia agree to a UN commission visit to disputed waters
item.description:
Thailand and Cambodia agreed to allow the conciliation commission formed under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea to visit disputed maritime areas off their coasts, according to a Permanent Court of Arbitration statement on Friday. The agreement came at the end of the third meeting of the proceedings in Kuala Lumpur from 24 to 27 November, and Thailand's Foreign Ministry said the visits will help the commission understand the areas' geography.
Sources: The Peninsula (Xinhua) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/28/11/2026/thailand-cambodia-to-allow-un-to-visit-disputed-maritime-areas · Bernama https://www.bernama.com/en/world/news.php?id=2640188
